pictureEditor.title: Frame the picture
pictureEditor.hint: Drag the picture, zoom with the wheel or the slider.
pictureEditor.fitHint: The whole picture in the frame, the rest takes the background
pictureEditor.fillHint: The frame filled, the picture cut if needed
pictureEditor.removeBackgroundHint: Erases from the edges the background colour and what looks like it
pictureEditor.eraserHint: A click on the picture removes the area of that colour
pictureEditor.removedLittle: Less than 1 % of the picture removed: raise the tolerance for a larger area.
pictureEditor.noPlainEdge: No plain background to remove on the edges: remove an area with the eraser, or keep the background.
pictureEditor.nothingHere: Nothing to remove here: the area is already transparent.
pictureEditor.outputTransparent: Saved as a square PNG of {{side}} px, transparent background.
pictureEditor.outputPlain: Saved as a square PNG of {{side}} px, {{colour}} background.

deleteConfirm.title: Confirm deletion
deleteConfirm.messagePermanent_one: {{count}} item will be permanently deleted. This action is irreversible.
deleteConfirm.messagePermanent_other: {{count}} items will be permanently deleted. This action is irreversible.
